comment: Stage 2 debt — a ratchet that only goes down. These case files have no canonical_request because the pure build/parse model cannot express them; spec/SCOPE.md declares both OUT OF 1.0 SCOPE (gemini.cached_content needs a /cachedContents side channel; openai.computer_use needs a new part type via MAP-1 amendment). They stay reachable via config.extensions/provider_data with no contract guarantee. Burn rule unchanged: remove each id in the same commit that attaches its canonical_request. tools/audit.py hard-fails on any NEW orphan not listed here and on any STALE entry whose case has gained a canonical_request.
